summary_1line: Bhishma advises on choosing righteous societies and kingdoms, then begins a discourse on detachment and the pursuit of liberation through Arishtanemi’s counsel to King Sagara.

image_candidates.scene_text: A lone seeker hastily leaves a town of corrupt men as if fleeing a room with a coiled snake on the floor.
In a virtuous kingdom, Brahmanas sit first at a sacred fire as priests chant 'Swaha, Swadha, Vashat' while the king looks on reverently.
An aging king quietly departs his palace at dawn, leaving behind his family to wander the world in search of liberation.
